title.zh: 授权土地局长分割属于菲律宾共和国、已不再用于军事目的军事保留地内土地，并按规定条件出售处分并为其他目的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing the Director of Lands to Subdivide the Lands Within Military Reservations Belonging to the Republic of the Philippines Which are No Longer Needed for Military Purposes, and to Dispose of the Same by Sale Subject to Certain Conditions, and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the Director of Lands to Subdivide the Lands Within Military Reservations Belonging to the Republic of the Philippines Which are No Longer Needed for Military Purposes, and to Dispose of the Same by Sale Subject to Certain Conditions, and for Other Purposes

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1948/ra_274_1948.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Director of Lands shall cause the subdivision of lands within military reservations owned by the Republic of the Philippines which may be declared by the President of the Philippines as no longer needed for military purposes.

Subject to the approval of the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources, the area of each lot within the subdivisions shall be determined by the Director of Lands according to the nature of the land, the number of prospective applicants, and the purpose for which it will be utilized.

All lands so subdivided, except such portion thereof as may be needed for the public service may, with the approval of the President of the Philippines, be sold to persons qualified to acquire agricultural public lands under the provisions of Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred forty-one, commonly known as "The Public Land Act," and Act Numbered Thirty hundred and thirty-eight of the Philippine Legislature: Provided, However, That in the sale thereof, first priority shall be given to bona fide occupants of such lands and thereafter to war veterans of the past war including members of the USAFFE, recognized guerrillas, and deserving members of unrecognized guerrilla organizations.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1948.
